name: Surreal Leather Headpiece Fashion
image_vibe: organic leather sculpture, warm artisanal realism

prompt.project_info: Create a tactile medium-shot portrait in a sunlit botanical tannery and workshop.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with serene distant gaze, wearing a cream high-collar waffle-knit coat and a sculptural cognac leather headpiece shaped like a segmented organic bulb; upright supported posture, natural skin pores, headpiece safely balanced.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft Rembrandt window light with warm room bounce and subtle backlight on leather edges, dusty warm quiet workshop.
prompt.technical_specs: Hasselblad H6D-100c, 80mm f/1.9, Kodak Portra 160, creamy skin tones, tactile leather grain, shallow depth of field.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic 4:5 editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman wearing a cream high-collar waffle-knit coat and a surreal cognac stitched-leather headpiece shaped like a segmented organic bulb, serene distant gaze, upright supported posture, sunlit botanical tannery with dried gourds, leather rolls, brass tools, dried plants and dust, soft Rembrandt window light, Hasselblad H6D-100c 80mm f/1.9, Kodak Portra 160 texture, no text.
